research.title: What 'Critical Cyber Capability' Means If You Ship Software
research.whyTrending: First model ever classified Critical for cyber under the Preparedness Framework - it can find and weaponize zero-days unaided. Enterprise access is off by default. This reshapes threat models, not just AI policy debates.

facts.pricing: $10/M input, $1/M cached input, $50/M output (2.5x GPT-5.6 Sol)

benchmarks.OSWorld 2.0: 72.6% at ~47% less time per task than Sol (~40 min vs 75 min)

facts.safety: First model at Critical cyber capability under Preparedness Framework; off by default for enterprise workspaces, admin must enable; 0% scope-exceeding vs 48% for Sol
facts.codexCli: v0.153.1 added first-class gpt-6-astra config; ~70% better token efficiency inside Codex harness
facts.codingCaveat: On pure coding indices lands near GPT-5.6 Sol, behind Fable 5.1; gains concentrated in agentic/computer-use/long-horizon work
